items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's what David's famous trombone player. Yeah, who was your favorite trombone player?

ctx.x: I see those fellas playing them out there and I went and bought me one.
That's what David's famous trombone player. Yeah, who was your favorite trombone player?
My famous trombone player was Harrison Bradley. Oh, yeah. And the next Albert Youngs, call him Boots.
